picorv32_pcpi_mul.summary: PicoRV32 PCPI multiply coprocessor: decodes MUL-family instructions, then iterates a shift-and-add carry-save accumulator over 64-bit operand registers under a down-counter, returning the result via pcpi_wr/pcpi_ready.

blocks.name: Instruction decoder
blocks.description: Decodes MUL opcodes into type and signedness flags; raises pcpi_wait.

anchors.name: pcpi_insn
anchors.why: Instruction word decoded into MUL/MULH/MULHSU/MULHU flags.

anchors.name: instr_mulh
anchors.why: Decoded MULH flag; representative of the four mul-type decode registers.

anchors.name: instr_any_mulh
anchors.why: High-half product select: sets counter length and pcpi_rd shift.

anchors.name: instr_rs1_signed
anchors.why: Selects signed extension of rs1 operand.

anchors.name: pcpi_wait
anchors.why: Tells CPU a multiply instruction is accepted and in progress.

blocks.name: Multiply controller
blocks.description: Idle/iterate state, step counter and finish pulse.

anchors.name: mul_waiting
anchors.why: Two-state controller: idle loading operands vs iterating the accumulator.

anchors.name: mul_counter
anchors.why: Iteration down-counter; bit 6 underflow ends multiplication.

anchors.name: mul_finish
anchors.why: Done pulse triggering pcpi_wr/pcpi_ready and result output.

anchors.name: mul_start
anchors.why: Rising edge of pcpi_wait starting the iteration.

blocks.name: Carry-save accumulator
blocks.description: Shift-and-add operand and accumulator registers with next-state logic.

anchors.name: rd
anchors.why: Carry-save accumulator sum register holding the product.

anchors.name: rdx
anchors.why: Carry-save accumulator carry register.

anchors.name: rs1
anchors.why: Multiplier operand shifted right each step.

anchors.name: rs2
anchors.why: Multiplicand operand shifted left each step.

anchors.name: next_rd
anchors.why: Combinational next accumulator sum from carry-chain adder.

anchors.name: this_rs2
anchors.why: Partial product: rs2 gated by current rs1 bit.

blocks.name: PCPI interface
blocks.description: Coprocessor request and result handshake with the CPU.

anchors.name: pcpi_valid
anchors.why: PCPI request valid qualifying instruction decode.

anchors.name: pcpi_rs1
anchors.why: First operand, sign/zero-extended into rs1.

anchors.name: pcpi_rs2
anchors.why: Second operand, sign/zero-extended into rs2.

anchors.name: pcpi_rd
anchors.why: Result output: low or high half of rd accumulator.

anchors.name: pcpi_ready
anchors.why: One-cycle completion pulse after mul_finish.

anchors.name: pcpi_wr
anchors.why: Write-back request for pcpi_rd, pulsed with pcpi_ready.

picorv32_pcpi_div.summary: PCPI coprocessor for RISC-V DIV/DIVU/REM/REMU: decodes the instruction, then runs a 32-iteration restoring shift-subtract divider on sign-corrected operands with sign fix-up on completion.

blocks.name: Instruction decoder
blocks.description: Decodes DIV/REM variants and generates wait and start

anchors.name: instr_div
anchors.why: Decoded op flag selecting signed handling and quotient output

anchors.name: pcpi_insn
anchors.why: Instruction word decoded into div/divu/rem/remu

anchors.name: pcpi_wait
anchors.why: Tells core a div/rem instruction is being processed

anchors.name: pcpi_wait_q
anchors.why: Delayed wait used for start edge detection

anchors.name: start
anchors.why: Rising edge of wait; loads operands and starts iteration

blocks.name: Divider control
blocks.description: Busy state and iteration mask sequencing completion

anchors.name: running
anchors.why: Two-state busy controller for the iterative divider

anchors.name: quotient_msk
anchors.why: One-hot bit position shifting right; zero ends iteration

anchors.name: pcpi_ready
anchors.why: One-cycle completion pulse when division finishes

anchors.name: pcpi_wr
anchors.why: Register writeback enable asserted with result

blocks.name: Divider datapath
blocks.description: Shift-subtract datapath and sign-corrected result

anchors.name: dividend
anchors.why: Partial remainder, reduced by divisor each step

anchors.name: divisor
anchors.why: Shifted divisor compared and subtracted each iteration

anchors.name: quotient
anchors.why: Quotient accumulated by OR-ing mask bits

anchors.name: outsign
anchors.why: Result sign latched at start, negates output

anchors.name: pcpi_rd
anchors.why: Result: signed quotient or remainder written back

blocks.name: PCPI request
blocks.description: Request valid and source operands from core

anchors.name: pcpi_valid
anchors.why: Coprocessor request valid gating instruction decode

anchors.name: pcpi_rs1
anchors.why: Dividend operand loaded, sign-corrected, into dividend register

anchors.name: pcpi_rs2
anchors.why: Divisor operand loaded, sign-corrected and shifted, into divisor

picorv32.summary: Multi-cycle RV32I CPU: one-hot cpu_state FSM sequences fetch/decode, register-file reads, ALU/shift execution and load/store through a mem_state-driven native memory interface.

blocks.name: Main controller
blocks.description: One-hot cpu_state FSM sequencing fetch, register read, execute, shift, load/store and trap.

anchors.name: cpu_state
anchors.why: One-hot main CPU FSM: fetch, ld_rs1, ld_rs2, exec, shift, stmem, ldmem, trap.

anchors.name: decoder_trigger
anchors.why: Pulse when instruction fetch completes; triggers decode and launches next instruction.

anchors.name: trap
anchors.why: CPU halted output set in cpu_state_trap on illegal or misaligned access.

anchors.name: latched_store
anchors.why: Marks result pending write-back to cpuregs at next fetch.

anchors.name: latched_branch
anchors.why: Taken branch/jump flag selecting reg_out as next_pc.

anchors.name: decoder_pseudo_trigger
anchors.why: Re-triggers decoder after load/store without new fetch.

anchors.name: launch_next_insn
anchors.why: Fetch state ready to start next instruction (no pending IRQ).

anchors.name: alu_wait
anchors.why: Extra ALU cycle stall flag (TWO_CYCLE_ALU, disabled).

anchors.name: reg_sh
anchors.why: Remaining shift amount counter for multi-cycle shift state.

blocks.name: Memory interface
blocks.description: mem_state machine issuing fetch/load/store transactions with look-ahead and byte-lane formatting.

anchors.name: mem_state
anchors.why: 2-bit memory interface FSM: idle, instruction/read wait, write wait, prefetch.

anchors.name: mem_valid
anchors.why: Memory bus request valid, raised by mem_state machine for fetch/load/store.

anchors.name: mem_ready
anchors.why: Memory acknowledge; with mem_valid forms mem_xfer completing a transfer.

anchors.name: mem_addr
anchors.why: Memory bus address, registered from look-ahead mem_la_addr.

anchors.name: mem_wdata
anchors.why: Store data to memory, registered from mem_la_wdata (replicated reg_op2).

anchors.name: mem_rdata
anchors.why: Memory read data: instructions into mem_rdata_q and load data via mem_rdata_word.

anchors.name: mem_done
anchors.why: Memory transaction complete; advances cpu_state and clears mem_do_* requests.

anchors.name: mem_do_rinst
anchors.why: Instruction-fetch request flag to memory interface.

anchors.name: mem_do_prefetch
anchors.why: Prefetch next instruction while current instruction executes.

anchors.name: mem_do_rdata
anchors.why: Load data read request flag set in ldmem.

anchors.name: mem_do_wdata
anchors.why: Store write request flag set in stmem; drives mem_la_write.

anchors.name: mem_wordsize
anchors.why: Selects word/half/byte lane formatting of wdata, wstrb and rdata_word.

anchors.name: mem_wstrb
anchors.why: Byte write strobes on memory bus; zero for reads.

anchors.name: mem_instr
anchors.why: Indicates current memory transaction is an instruction fetch.

anchors.name: mem_la_addr
anchors.why: Look-ahead address: next_pc for fetch or reg_op1 for data.

anchors.name: mem_la_read
anchors.why: Look-ahead read request one cycle before mem_valid.

anchors.name: mem_la_write
anchors.why: Look-ahead write request; gates mem_wstrb.

anchors.name: mem_rdata_word
anchors.why: Byte/halfword-extracted load data before sign extension into reg_out.

anchors.name: mem_16bit_buffer
anchors.why: Upper halfword buffer for compressed ISA fetch (disabled).

blocks.name: Instruction decoder
blocks.description: Two-stage decode of fetched word into instr_* and is_* flags, register indices and immediate.

anchors.name: mem_rdata_q
anchors.why: Latched fetched instruction word feeding second-stage decode and immediates.

anchors.name: is_lb_lh_lw_lbu_lhu
anchors.why: Representative opcode-class decode flag steering ld_rs1 dispatch to load path.

anchors.name: instr_trap
anchors.why: Illegal/unsupported instruction decode sending FSM to trap or PCPI.

anchors.name: is_beq_bne_blt_bge_bltu_bgeu
anchors.why: Conditional branch class flag selecting compare path in exec.

anchors.name: is_lui_auipc_jal
anchors.why: Upper-immediate/jal class flag routing reg_pc and imm to ALU.

anchors.name: instr_add
anchors.why: Representative per-instruction decode flag from mem_rdata_q.

anchors.name: decoded_rs1
anchors.why: Source register 1 index reading cpuregs.

anchors.name: decoded_rs2
anchors.why: Source register 2 index reading cpuregs.

anchors.name: decoded_rd
anchors.why: Decoded destination index copied into latched_rd.

anchors.name: decoded_imm
anchors.why: Decoded sign-extended immediate for ALU, address and branch target.

blocks.name: Register file
blocks.description: cpuregs array with write-back mux, write enable and two read ports.

anchors.name: cpuregs
anchors.why: 32x32 register file written at latched_rd, read via decoded_rs1/rs2.

anchors.name: latched_rd
anchors.why: Destination register index for cpuregs write-back.

anchors.name: cpuregs_write
anchors.why: Register-file write enable, asserted at fetch when latched_store or irq save.

anchors.name: cpuregs_wrdata
anchors.why: Write-back data mux: return PC, alu_out_q or reg_out.

anchors.name: cpuregs_rs1
anchors.why: Register-file read port 1 value loaded into reg_op1.

anchors.name: cpuregs_rs2
anchors.why: Register-file read port 2 value loaded into reg_op2/reg_sh.

blocks.name: ALU and operand datapath
blocks.description: Operand registers feeding add/sub, compare, logic and shift ALU; results collected in reg_out.

anchors.name: reg_op1
anchors.why: ALU operand 1 / shift accumulator / load-store address register.

anchors.name: reg_op2
anchors.why: ALU operand 2 from rs2 or immediate; store data source.

anchors.name: reg_out
anchors.why: Result register: load data, counters, branch target; written back to cpuregs.

anchors.name: alu_out
anchors.why: ALU result mux: add/sub, compare, xor/or/and, shifts.

anchors.name: alu_out_0
anchors.why: Branch/compare result deciding taken branch.

anchors.name: alu_add_sub
anchors.why: Adder/subtractor of reg_op1 and reg_op2.

anchors.name: alu_out_q
anchors.why: Registered ALU result written back when latched_stalu.

blocks.name: Program counter
blocks.description: PC, sequential next PC and branch-target selection for fetch addressing.

anchors.name: reg_pc
anchors.why: Program counter of the current instruction, loaded from current_pc at fetch.

anchors.name: reg_next_pc
anchors.why: Sequential/jal next PC; source of next_pc when no branch.

anchors.name: next_pc
anchors.why: Fetch address: branch target reg_out or reg_next_pc.

blocks.name: Counters
blocks.description: 64-bit cycle and instret counters read by rdcycle/rdinstr.

anchors.name: count_cycle
anchors.why: 64-bit cycle counter readable via rdcycle.

anchors.name: count_instr
anchors.why: 64-bit retired-instruction counter readable via rdinstr.

blocks.name: PCPI co-processor interface
blocks.description: Hands unsupported instructions to external or built-in mul/div co-processors (disabled).

anchors.name: pcpi_valid
anchors.why: Co-processor request for unsupported instructions (PCPI disabled).

anchors.name: pcpi_int_ready
anchors.why: Merged PCPI/mul/div ready completing co-processor instruction.

anchors.name: pcpi_timeout
anchors.why: Co-processor timeout causing trap when no PCPI responds.

anchors.name: pcpi_timeout_counter
anchors.why: Countdown timer for PCPI response timeout.

blocks.name: Interrupt controller
blocks.description: IRQ pending/mask, timer, entry sequencing and eoi (ENABLE_IRQ disabled).

anchors.name: irq_state
anchors.why: IRQ entry sequencer saving PC and pending mask (IRQ disabled).

anchors.name: irq_pending
anchors.why: Pending interrupt vector gating IRQ entry (IRQ disabled).

anchors.name: irq_mask
anchors.why: Software interrupt mask set by maskirq.

anchors.name: irq_active
anchors.why: In-interrupt-handler flag, cleared by retirq.

anchors.name: timer
anchors.why: IRQ timer down-counter set by timer instruction.

anchors.name: eoi
anchors.why: End-of-interrupt vector output.

blocks.name: Trace and debug
blocks.description: Instruction trace output and simulation-only debug shadow registers.

anchors.name: trace_valid
anchors.why: Trace output valid (ENABLE_TRACE disabled).

anchors.name: trace_data
anchors.why: Trace payload: branch target or written-back value.

spimemio_xfer.summary: SPI flash byte transfer engine: latches a byte command, then shifts obuffer/ibuffer over 1/2/4-bit (optionally DDR) flash IO under bit and dummy-cycle counters, returning tagged read bytes.

blocks.name: Request intake
blocks.description: Accepts byte command and latches mode, tag and read flags.

anchors.name: din_valid
anchors.why: Byte request valid; with din_ready latches transfer parameters and starts shifting.

anchors.name: din_ready
anchors.why: Accepts new byte when previous transfer finishes (next_fetch).

anchors.name: din_data
anchors.why: Byte to transmit, loaded into obuffer; dummy cycle count on reads.

anchors.name: xfer_ddr
anchors.why: Latched DDR mode selecting shift case and dout_valid timing.

anchors.name: xfer_qspi
anchors.why: Latched quad mode selecting 4-bit IO shift case; xfer_dspi sibling.

anchors.name: xfer_rd
anchors.why: Read flag disabling IO output enables in multi-bit modes.

anchors.name: xfer_tag
anchors.why: Holds request tag returned as dout_tag after delay.

blocks.name: Shift datapath
blocks.description: Shifts obuffer out and ibuffer in over 1/2/4 IO lines.

anchors.name: obuffer
anchors.why: Output shift register driving flash IO data bits MSB first.

anchors.name: ibuffer
anchors.why: Input shift register collecting flash IO sample bits.

anchors.name: flash_io0_do
anchors.why: Flash IO data out bit from obuffer; io1-3 do/oe replicate.

blocks.name: Transfer sequencing
blocks.description: Bit and dummy counters, SPI clock and fetch completion.

anchors.name: count
anchors.why: Remaining bit counter decremented per shift; zero completes byte.

anchors.name: dummy_count
anchors.why: Dummy clock cycle counter that suspends shifting while nonzero.

anchors.name: flash_clk
anchors.why: Generated SPI clock toggled while counting; edges select shift vs sample.

anchors.name: flash_csb
anchors.why: Flash chip select, asserted low on accepted request.

anchors.name: next_fetch
anchors.why: Byte-complete flag gating din_ready and dout_valid.

blocks.name: Response output
blocks.description: Presents received byte and tag with valid pulse.

anchors.name: dout_valid
anchors.why: Pulse marking received byte ready, DDR-aware timing from fetch.

anchors.name: dout_data
anchors.why: Received byte output driven from ibuffer.

spimemio.summary: SPI flash memory-mapped read controller: an FSM sequences reset/wakeup, command, address, mode and dummy bytes into a spimemio_xfer engine, assembles tagged read bytes into 32-bit words with sequential prefetch, plus a config register for bit-bang override.

blocks.name: Read sequencer FSM
blocks.description: Sequences flash wakeup, command, address, mode and data byte fetches

anchors.name: state
anchors.why: Sequencer: reset/wakeup, read command, address bytes, mode, then repeated data byte fetches

anchors.name: jump
anchors.why: Non-sequential access: aborts transfer, restarts FSM at command or address

anchors.name: softreset
anchors.why: Resets FSM when config disabled or config register written

anchors.name: xfer_resetn
anchors.why: Resets xfer engine between commands and on jump

anchors.name: rd_wait
anchors.why: Prefetched word unclaimed; stalls next data byte fetch in state 12

anchors.name: rd_inc
anchors.why: Selects incrementing rd_addr for sequential reads vs loading addr

blocks.name: Memory bus and word assembly
blocks.description: Assembles bytes into rdata, tracks prefetched address and ready

anchors.name: valid
anchors.why: Memory read request from CPU; starts address phase and clears rd_wait

anchors.name: ready
anchors.why: Read done when requested addr matches prefetched rd_addr and rd_valid

anchors.name: addr
anchors.why: Read address, sent as three address bytes and compared with rd_addr

anchors.name: rdata
anchors.why: 32-bit read word assembled from buffer and fourth tagged byte

anchors.name: buffer
anchors.why: Collects first three read bytes by dout_tag before rdata assembly

anchors.name: rd_addr
anchors.why: Address of buffered word; increments by 4 for sequential prefetch

anchors.name: rd_valid
anchors.why: rdata holds valid word for rd_addr; gates ready and jump

blocks.name: Xfer engine interface
blocks.description: Byte command/response handshake to spimemio_xfer shift engine

anchors.name: din_valid
anchors.why: Byte command valid to xfer engine, raised in each FSM send state

anchors.name: din_ready
anchors.why: Xfer engine accepted byte; advances FSM state

anchors.name: din_data
anchors.why: Byte to send: command opcode, address bytes, mode or dummy count

anchors.name: din_tag
anchors.why: Tag identifying which result byte position a read returns

anchors.name: din_cont
anchors.why: Continue flag to xfer engine to keep chip select active

anchors.name: din_qspi
anchors.why: Selects quad-SPI mode for xfer bytes after command

anchors.name: din_ddr
anchors.why: Selects DDR/dual mode, decoded into xfer_dspi and xfer_ddr

anchors.name: din_rd
anchors.why: Enables read direction / dummy cycles in xfer engine

anchors.name: dout_valid
anchors.why: Xfer engine returns byte; stores into buffer/rdata, advances FSM

anchors.name: dout_data
anchors.why: Returned read byte placed into buffer or rdata

anchors.name: dout_tag
anchors.why: Returned byte tag selecting buffer slot or final rdata

blocks.name: Config register
blocks.description: Software config: mode, dummy cycles, bit-bang pin control

anchors.name: config_en
anchors.why: Selects memory-mapped xfer engine vs bit-bang config outputs on flash pins

anchors.name: config_ddr
anchors.why: DDR mode config: chooses read command and delayed IO outputs

anchors.name: config_qspi
anchors.why: Quad SPI config: selects command opcode and mode byte path

anchors.name: config_cont
anchors.why: Continuous read mode: mode byte and jump restart state

anchors.name: config_dummy
anchors.why: Dummy cycle count sent to xfer engine

anchors.name: config_oe
anchors.why: Bit-bang output enables for flash IO when config_en low

anchors.name: config_do
anchors.why: Bit-bang data outputs for flash IO when config_en low

anchors.name: cfgreg_we
anchors.why: Byte write enables for config register fields; triggers softreset

anchors.name: cfgreg_di
anchors.why: Config register write data

anchors.name: cfgreg_do
anchors.why: Config readback with live flash pin states

blocks.name: Flash pin mux
blocks.description: Selects xfer engine or bit-bang config onto flash pins, DDR delay

anchors.name: xfer_io0_90
anchors.why: Negedge-delayed IO data for DDR output timing

anchors.name: flash_io0_do
anchors.why: Flash IO output data muxed from xfer engine, DDR delay or config

anchors.name: flash_csb
anchors.why: Flash chip select muxed from xfer engine or config_csb

anchors.name: flash_clk
anchors.why: Flash serial clock muxed from xfer engine or config_clk

simpleuart.summary: Simple UART with a programmable baud divider register, a counter-driven receive state machine shifting into a one-byte buffer, and a shift-register transmitter with bit counter.

blocks.name: Baud divider config
blocks.description: Programmable divider register read back on reg_div_do

anchors.name: cfg_divider
anchors.why: Byte-writable baud divider compared by both RX and TX counters

anchors.name: reg_div_we
anchors.why: Per-byte write enables for divider register

blocks.name: Receiver

anchors.name: recv_state
anchors.why: Receive controller: idle, start-bit half wait, data bits, stop

anchors.name: recv_divcnt

anchors.name: recv_pattern

anchors.name: ser_rx

anchors.name: reg_dat_re
anchors.why: Data read command clearing receive buffer valid

blocks.name: Transmitter

anchors.name: send_pattern
anchors.why: TX shift register with start/stop framing driving ser_tx

anchors.name: send_bitcnt
anchors.why: Remaining TX bits; busy indication for wait and new writes

anchors.name: send_divcnt
anchors.why: TX baud counter timing bit shifts against divider

anchors.name: send_dummy
anchors.why: Pending idle-frame flag after reset or divider write

anchors.name: ser_tx
anchors.why: Serial transmit line from TX shift register LSB

anchors.name: reg_dat_we
anchors.why: Data write command loading TX frame

anchors.name: reg_dat_wait
anchors.why: Stalls data writes while transmitter busy

picosoc_mem.summary: Single-port synchronous RAM: a 256-word 32-bit memory array with registered read data and per-byte write enables.

blocks.name: Memory array
blocks.description: Byte-writable synchronous RAM with registered read port

anchors.name: mem
anchors.why: 256x32 memory array written per byte lane and read every cycle

anchors.name: addr
anchors.why: Word address indexing mem for both read and write

anchors.why: 4-bit byte write enables gating each byte lane of mem

picosoc.summary: PicoRV32 SoC: the CPU's native memory bus is address-decoded to on-chip RAM, an SPI flash XIP controller, UART registers and an external iomem port, with a priority read-data mux and OR-ed ready.

anchors.name: mem_addr

anchors.name: spimem_rdata

anchors.name: flash_clk

anchors.name: flash_io0_di
anchors.why: Representative flash IO input data bit (quad IO0..3).

blocks.name: UART

blocks.name: On-chip RAM
